description: 1. Agent reads SKILL.md to discover the three scripts (create-agent.sh, delete-agent.sh) and the exact positional argument order: <agent-id> <agent-name> <app-id> <app-secret> [model] [description]. 2. Runs: ./create-agent.sh tuikuan 退款助手 cli_tuikuan001 secret_tuikuan deepseek-v3 '退款专员，处理订单退款问题' — must use the non-default model deepseek-v3 and correct arg order. 3. Runs: ./create-agent.sh dingdan 订单助手 cli_dingdan002 secret_dingdan — omits model (defaults to glm-5) and provides description as 6th arg if desired. 4. Runs: ./create-agent.sh testbot 测试机器人 cli_testbot999 secret_test, then ./delete-agent.sh testbot — must NOT attempt to delete 'main'. 5. Runs: openclaw gateway restart — mandatory post-creation step per SKILL.md. Eval checks: openclaw.json has correct agents.list=[main,tuikuan,dingdan], correct feishu accounts, bindings, agentToAgent.allow entries, tuikuan model=deepseek-v3, dingdan model=glm-5, testbot fully removed, gateway restart count>=1.
